units.source_text: “人嘛，总会在什么地方有一种宽大的美德。

en.t: People, after all, always have some generous virtue somewhere in them.

units.source_text: 尽管父亲是个十足的守财奴，但也会有宽宏大量的地方。

en.t: Even though my father was a complete miser, there were still places where he could be broad-minded and generous.

units.source_text: 我虽然是妾房生的孩子，却作为哥哥母亲的孩子让我上了户籍。

en.t: Although I was the child of a concubine, he had me entered in the family register as the child of my elder brother's mother.

units.source_text: 而且不知道真是父亲的孩子，还是谁的孩子。”

en.t: And no one even knew whether I was really my father's child, or whose child I was.
